thread:
ana: Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the Reserved Pools contract flexibility feature before the next sales cycle. Customer asks rolling: per-tenant soft quotas, burst carryover, and a tunable decay window. Can we do an MVP that doesn't require a billing schema change?

mike: Short answer: maybe. We can implement soft quotas + carryover in the serving layer without changing billing records if we treat carryover as an operational headroom token not exposed to invoices. billing will push back if customers expect visibility.

sofia: Proposal: two-tier approach
1) v1 (MVP): Reserved pool + per-tenant soft quota + burst credits with fixed decay (no billing changes). Acceptance: can assign credits, preempt when hard cap hit, metrics for visibility.
2) v2: expose carryover to billing + per-contract granularity + configurable decay curves.

taylor: I sketched autoscale policy parameters we could ship in v1 (very conservative):
```
autoscale_policy:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 10
  burst_credit_window: 3600  # seconds
  burst_decay: 0.5         # half-life factor per window
  preempt_threshold: 0.95
  soft_quota_enabled: true
```
This avoids per-token billing changes and gives Sales something to promise.

marco: Ops concerns: how will this interact with Dedicated preemption? If soft quota is exhausted we need clear escalation: preempt lower-tier faults, not customers with SLA. Also we need visibility in Console (burst credits, carryover). Can we fake the visibility in v1 by showing estimated "available burst" (derived from internal tokens) without modifying invoices?

mike: Yes, estimated metrics are fine. Implementation plan: add a burst-credit ledger in runtime that tracks token accrual/consumption per-tenant, emits metrics (prometheus), and exposes via Console read-only. No billing hook for v1.

ana: @ana (oops typo) — can we call out launch criteria? Sales needs a checklist for customer sign-off.

ana (ana): Launch criteria (draft):
- feature flag gated and tested in staging
- autoscale policy covers p95 latency within SLA for 95% of bursts
- metrics: token balance, token consumption rate, preemption events instrumented
- Console: "Burst credits" widget and per-tenant estimated available burst
- Operational playbook: how to revoke/transfer burst credits and escalation runbook
- Legal: contract language for "soft credits are operational and not invoiced" signed by finance/legal

sofia: Also add an eval: run a replay of 2 weeks of customer traffic and verify 1) p95 latency under expected burst, 2) billing delta under <5% variance vs baseline.

taylor: QA checklist: can we include a chaos test that simulates 3x expected burst for 30s to ensure graceful degradation and fallback to hosted model variants?

marco: Ops runbook items: who owns manual credit adjustments? where do we log disputes? propose oncall-level ops -> support -> billing escalation path.

mike: Dependencies:
- serving: runtime ledger + preemption hooks (ENG-RUNTIME)
- console: UI for token balance + per-tenant view (ENG-PLATFORM)
- billing/legal: contract wording sign-off (FINANCE/LEGAL)
- sales: pilot customers and SLA expectations (GTM)

sofia: Risks:
- If we promise carryover and can't support billing visibility, customers will push for invoice-level items.
- If decay math is wrong we could create unbounded headroom. Need limits and guardrails.

ana (ana): Next steps:
- Mike: prototype runtime ledger + prometheus metrics (due EOD Friday)
- Taylor: UX mockups for Console widget and tenant view (EOD Monday)
- Marco: ops runbook draft + escalation flow (Wed)
- Sofia: evaluation harness plan + replay dataset selection (Wed)
- I'll sync with legal/sales Thurs and push contract language to #sales-private.

marco: One more ask — can we expose an opt-in "cost-visible" flag per-customer (if they want carryover on invoice)? That would be v2 but Sales wants to know roadmap.

mike: Yes mark as v2. We'll also need to map ledger tokens to tokenized billing lines which is non-trivial.

taylor: Sales note: Pilot customers (ACME, Meridian) said carryover is make-or-break. They also want a 30-day trial of carryover before committing. Add to pilot asks.

sofia: I'll add the replay test config: pick two high-burst tenants + 4 medium tenants, simulate 2x daily burst for 14 days, measure preemption and SLA hits.

ana (ana): OK team — I'll open a short RFC with the v1/v2 split, attach the mockups and acceptance criteria, and set a follow-up sync next Tue. Thanks! :thumbsup:

sre-bot: deploy-bot: feature/reserved-pools-ledger deployed to staging at 1763880200. Tests queued.

mike: noted — will verify metrics emission once CI completes.
